description: Create a folder to organise QR codes, optionally nested under a parent. Creating a folder that already exists (same name, same parent) returns the existing one, so it's safe to call repeatedly.

parent.description: Parent folder id or slug to nest under (optional).

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: create_folder

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.

parent.description: Parent folder id, null at the top level.
